path.description: The path at which to create the files, relative to the current workspace.

project.description: Generate in specific Angular CLI workspace project

swaggerSchemaUrl.description: Source of the OpenAPI/Swagger schema: an http(s) URL, or a path to a local JSON file (absolute, relative to the project root, or a file:// URL).

eslintFix.description: Run the host project's ESLint with autofix on generated files, using the project's own configuration (import sorting, commas, quotes, etc.). Never blocks generation: failures are reported as warnings and files keep their generated content.

legacyOptionalProperties.description: Legacy optionality: mark an interface property optional ('?') when it is nullable instead of when it is absent from the object schema's 'required' array. Escape hatch for back-ends that do not emit 'required' yet. Nullability ('| null' in the type) is unaffected.
